questions.q: Q1: Can every capability be discovered?
questions.evidence: 14 capabilities declared in graph; ENGINE_TO_CAPABILITY maps 14 components

questions.q: Q2: Can every capability be mapped to production sources?
questions.evidence: 65 source→capability edges

questions.q: Q3: Can every capability be mapped to executable verification?
questions.evidence: 14 capabilities have unit/integration/property/invariant surfaces; observation-only surfaces exist for audit/architecture

questions.q: Q4: Can evidence validity be determined deterministically?
questions.evidence: validate_ci_evidence() checks 8 drift categories; decide_reuse() applies 13 enumerated rules

questions.q: Q5: Can stale evidence be rejected?
questions.evidence: R-SRC-001 (source drift), R-SRC-003 (test drift), R-CFG-001/002 (config/toolchain), R-POP-001 (population)

questions.q: Q6: Can CI evidence enter the canonical evidence model?
questions.evidence: ingest_ci_evidence() converts CIEvidenceRecord → ExecutionEvidence; semantic_equivalence() validates 6 dimensions

questions.q: Q7: Can local and CI evidence be correlated?
questions.evidence: semantic_equivalence() tested with simulated records; 6-dimension check passes

questions.q: Q8: Can verification scope be enforced?
questions.evidence: EvidenceAwarePlanner.plan() produces selected_tasks + excluded_tasks with explicit cause; scope_safe helpers in executor_pipeline

questions.q: Q9: Can shared dependencies propagate invalidation correctly?
questions.answer: PARTIALLY (isolated engine changes correct; shared infra changes need enhancement)
questions.evidence: R-SRC-001 handles single-engine source changes; R-SRC-002 requires explicit 'shared::' prefix — not auto-detected from file paths
questions.mechanism: evidence_reuse.INVALIDATION_RULES; R-SRC-002 gap identified in shared-infrastructure-impact.json

questions.q: Q10: Can the planner determine minimum defensible verification?
questions.evidence: Real scenario: 1 task selected, 13 excluded (92.86% reduction); no_full_campaign=true guaranteed

questions.q: Q11: Can the executor run only the selected verification?
questions.evidence: executor_pipeline.execute_mutation_task(component) targets single component; build_executable_plan filters to selected tasks

questions.q: Q12: Can the forensic record explain the entire causal chain?
questions.evidence: validate_forensic_record() enforces 12 CAUSAL_CHAIN_STAGES; real-master-scenario-full.json passes with complete=true

questions.q: Q13: Can the Diagnostic Agent answer all nine canonical questions?
questions.evidence: DiagnosticForensicAgent.diagnose() produces q1-q9 + record_validation + explainability; determinism verified (C42.30 TestDeterminism)

questions.q: Q14: Can failures be correctly classified?
questions.evidence: FailureKind enum (VERIFICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, EVIDENCE, SCOPE, CONFIGURATION, CERTIFICATION); classify_ci_failure() precedence: evidence > infra > verification

questions.q: Q15: Can uncertainty be explicitly represented?
questions.evidence: Uncertainty dataclass with kind/subject/detail/gates_certification/recommendation; 7 uncertainty kinds in UNCERTAINTY_KINDS

questions.q: Q16: Can strengthening proposals be evidence-derived?
questions.evidence: generate_proposal() takes SurvivorEvidence → StrengtheningProposal (Class-A) or RejectionRecord (B/C/D/E); hypothesis from mutation_operator template

questions.q: Q17: Can strengthening be targeted and revalidated?
questions.evidence: targeted_revalidation() runs executor on component only; accepts if target killed + zero regressions; used_full_campaign always False

questions.q: Q18: Can production modification remain outside autonomous authority?
questions.evidence: strengthening.py: no production write path; ApprovalDecision.approved always False; gate_full_campaign rejects test_addition/score_improvement_desire

questions.q: Q19: Can historical evidence improve future decisions?
questions.evidence: C42.26 population evidence reused across runs; ComponentMeasurement.fingerprint() enables cross-run comparison; SurvivorRegistry gap identified (not yet implemented)

questions.q: Q20: Can the system produce a defensible certification decision from artifacts alone?
questions.evidence: DiagnosticReport.q9_verdict deterministic from ForensicExecutionRecord; Explainability provides mandatory answers; real master scenario → CERTIFIABLE
